subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Skeptic
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"skeptic"** means a person **inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions**. (संशयवादी)

 
 
• **Example:** She was a **skeptic** who always questioned the effectiveness of new policies.
 
 
 
• **"Believer"** refers to someone **who accepts something as true, especially without proof. **(विश्वासी)
 
 
• **Example:** He is a firm **believer** in the power of positive thinking.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'skeptic'** is **'believer'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Infidel** (नास्तिक): A person who does not believe in religion or who adheres to a religion other than one's own.

 
 
• **Example:** In historical contexts,** infidels** were often persecuted for their beliefs.
 
 
 
• **Careful** (सावधान): Making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or harm; cautious.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very** careful **when crossing the busy street.
 
 
 
• **Atheist** (नास्तिक): A person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
 
 
• **Example:** As an **atheist**, he does not participate in any religious rituals.
